articles.summary: CARSON CITY, Nev., Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - BioVie Inc. (NASDAQ: BIVI) (“BioVie” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage company developing innovative drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative diseases, today announced the Company has been invited to present at the 2026 RECOVER–Treating Long COVID (RECOVER-TLC) Hybrid Workshop, hosted by the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) and the Foundation for the National Institutes of Health (FNIH) from November 4–5, 2026, in Bethesda, Maryland. Dr. Penelope Markham, BioVie’s Senior Vice President and Program Lead for Long COVID, will share results from the Company’s Phase 2 ADDRESS-LC trial evaluating bezisterim for the treatment of the neurological symptoms of Long COVID at the “Recent Insights from Long COVID Clinical Trials” Panel Discussion on Thursday, November 5, being held from 9:10 –10:10 a.m. ET. articles.summary: CARSON CITY, Nev., Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - BioVie Inc. (NASDAQ: BIVI) (“BioVie” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage company developing innovative drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative diseases, today announced that two abstracts detailing results from the Company’s ADDRESS-LC Phase 2 trial in Long COVID, and SUNRISE-PD Phase 2 trial of bezisterim in Parkinson’s Disease have been accepted for presentation at ANA2026 , the annual meeting of the American Neurological Association. Results of the two studies will be presented as posters during the conference. ANA2026 will be held in San Diego, CA from October 17-20, 2026.
